title: Codex adapter resume and preserved review flow
description: Implement Codex session capture, question publication, same-session reply via codex exec resume, validation feedback, and draft-PR/checkpoint preservation for every pause/final turn.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Validation of the merged transparent-delegation work found that neither runtime implements saved-session reply. The current Codex adapter is one-shot `codex exec --json`: it records a session ID only after the turn exits, while `router resume` only resumes scheduler operation. This story now owns the required lifecycle: detect/persist a question, publish it as an issue comment, move to Blocked, then invoke the same saved session with the human reply and preserve the resulting work for Review.
